title: Chinese Chicken Salad with Sesame Dressing
description: Chinese Chicken Salad with Sesame Dressing is a fresh, colorful restaurant-style salad featuring tender poached chicken, crisp mixed greens, shredded cabbage, carrots, cucumber, and bell peppers. A fragrant sesame dressing brings together savory soy sauce, tangy rice vinegar, toasted sesame oil, ginger, garlic, and a touch of sweetness, while toasted nuts and sesame seeds add satisfying crunch.

ingredients.title: For the Salad
items: Mixed greens – 4 cups (romaine, napa cabbage, frisée)
Toasted sliced almonds or cashews – ¼ cup

ingredients.title: For the Sesame Dressing
items: Sesame oil – 1 tbsp, toasted if available
Mayonnaise or Greek yogurt – 2 tbsp (optional, for a creamy version)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Poaching the Chicken
steps: Add 2 cups water, salt, and white pepper to a small pot.
Bring the water to a gentle simmer rather than a vigorous boil.
Add the chicken breasts and poach for 12–15 minutes, or until fully cooked and the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C).
Remove the chicken from the poaching liquid and allow it to cool.
Once cooled, shred or thinly slice the chicken.
Drizzle with 1 tsp sesame oil to keep the chicken moist and aromatic.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Preparing the Salad Base
steps: Combine mixed greens, shredded red cabbage, shredded carrots, julienned cucumber, sliced bell pepper, and green onions in a large mixing bowl.
Add chopped cilantro if using.
Toss gently to distribute the vegetables evenly.
For extra crunch, soak the shredded cabbage and carrots in ice water for 5 minutes, then drain thoroughly before mixing.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Preparing the Sesame Dressing
steps: Whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, neutral oil, honey or sugar, grated ginger, and minced garlic.
Add chili oil if a spicy finish is desired.
For the creamy variation, whisk in mayonnaise or Greek yogurt until completely smooth.
Taste and adjust the balance with additional honey for sweetness, vinegar for acidity, or seasoning as needed.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Toasting the Garnishes
steps: Place the sesame seeds and sliced almonds or cashews in a dry pan.
Toast lightly over medium heat for 2–3 minutes until fragrant and golden.
Remove from the pan immediately and allow them to cool slightly.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Assembling the Salad
steps: Add the shredded or sliced chicken to the prepared salad base.
Drizzle approximately 3–4 tbsp of sesame dressing over the salad.
Toss gently until the chicken and vegetables are evenly coated.
Reserve additional dressing on the side for serving.
Sprinkle toasted almonds or cashews and sesame seeds over the top.
Garnish with fresh cilantro if using.

instruction.title: Step 6 – Plating & Serving
steps: Arrange the salad neatly in a shallow serving bowl or wide plate.
Position several slices of chicken prominently on top for an elegant presentation.
Finish with a light sprinkle of sesame seeds and toasted nuts.
Serve immediately while the vegetables remain crisp.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve chilled or slightly cool as a light appetizer or main course.
Pair with vegetable fried rice, steamed dumplings, spring rolls, or noodle dishes.
Serve extra sesame dressing on the side for guests who prefer a richer coating.
For a more substantial meal, add crispy wonton strips or extra roasted cashews.

chefTips: Poach the chicken at a gentle simmer rather than a rolling boil to keep the meat tender and juicy.
Use an instant-read thermometer to ensure the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) without overcooking.
Soaking shredded cabbage and carrots briefly in ice water gives the salad an especially crisp restaurant-style texture.
Toast sesame seeds and nuts lightly in a dry pan to intensify their aroma and flavor.
Keep the dressing separate until shortly before serving if preparing the salad in advance.
Balance the dressing carefully; the ideal profile combines salty, sweet, tangy, nutty, and lightly spicy flavors.
For professional plating, use a shallow wide plate and arrange the chicken slices over the colorful vegetables rather than mixing everything completely.
For a lighter dressing, omit the mayonnaise or Greek yogurt; for a richer creamy version, whisk either one in until smooth.
